pirs.statement: Has the Tidö government achieved legislative completion of its 10-year school reform package before the September 2026 election?
pirs.answer_summary: YES — HD01UbU28 (UbU, 2026-05-08) adopted unanimously, closes the last statutory gap. Reform complete pre-election.
